Fit and assess the descending taxonomies of the reference workflow

Source: R/assessment.R
fit_guided_ssf.Rd

By default, tries HDT/F/R (if a target is supplied), then T/F/R, T/E, and Other. Supply an ordered list to use custom taxonomies or mix them with built-in candidates. The first candidate passing its checks is selected. Returns every attempted candidate, including numerical failures. If no candidate passes, status is no_accepted_model; it does not reinterpret numerical failure as evidence of homogeneous behaviour.

Usage

fit_guided_ssf(
  data,
  convention,
  target = NULL,
  n_starts = 5L,
  short_iter = 30L,
  long_iter = 300L,
  spread = 0.5,
  seed = NULL,
  min_occupancy = 0.05,
  persistence_bounds = c(0.05, 0.95),
  min_mean_gap = 0,
  engine = c("native", "R"),
  score_tolerance = 0.01,
  normalization = c("importance", "exact"),
  step_ar = FALSE,
  taxonomies = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Case-control step data.

convention

Required kernel convention, see movement_metrics().

target

Optional name of a target-direction column for the built-in HDT candidate. Custom candidates supply covariates in their formula.

n_starts, short_iter, long_iter, spread, seed

Fitting controls, see fit_ssf().

min_occupancy, persistence_bounds, min_mean_gap, score_tolerance

Assessment controls, see assess_taxonomy().

engine

Fitting engine passed to fit_ssf().

normalization

importance for case-control data, exact for observed ssf_steps and compatible analytically normalised kernels.

step_ar

Logical. Include state-specific length autoregression in every candidate when using exact normalisation.

taxonomies

NULL for the reference sequence, or a nonempty ordered list of ssf_taxonomy() specifications and/or built-in taxonomy names. Include "Other" explicitly to try the one-state fallback in a custom sequence.

Value

A guided_ssf object with selection status, selected fit and assessment, and the complete candidate history. No model averaging, post-selection confidence calibration or HSMM is performed.
